'''Lightning of Three Prongs''' is a [[sword form]]. The movement of the form is unknown.

==In practice==
During their fight in [[Falme]], [[Rand al'Thor]] meets [[Turak Aladon]]'s use of [[Leaf on the Breeze]].{{ref/book|2|45}} During his practice in [[Caemlyn]], one of Rand's opponents uses this form. Rand breaks through it with [[The Boar Rushes Down the Mountain]].{{ref/book|6|1}} Either [[Galadedrid Damodred]] or [[Eamon Valda]] used this form while the other used [[Lizard in the Thornbush]] as a counter.{{ref/book|11|p}}
